items.text: agents/default.py: the while loop in run()
items.why: The loop runs each step until the agent exits.
The environment runs the command the model asked for.
The system template is the instruction the model reads first.
The retry helper decides which model call failures are tried again.
The save step writes the trajectory, with cost and exit status.
In confirm mode, the agent waits for a person before a command runs.
